decontamination_notes: Real feature from bitflags/bitflags PR #489, merged 2026-06-05, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets (within the suite's >= 2026-06-01 window; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing). Adds Flags::iter_equal_names: src/iter.rs gains the IterEqualNames iterator (filtering IterDefinedNames by bits equality, so aliases and convenience flags are included) and src/traits.rs the trait method (multi_file). Kept as a second easy anchor for the difficulty band. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (9196a3a8): full crate minus .git/.github, third-party deps vendored (lockfile committed — the upstream .gitignore's Cargo.lock rule is stripped so offline builds reproduce; deps are dev/optional-only, 37MB vendor). MIT/Apache LICENSEs preserved; rust-2024 image for vendored dev-dep MSRV headroom. Hidden tests are auto-discovered integration tests: vb_equal_names.rs (fail_to_pass) references the new method and fails to compile at base — all 4 commands verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch (alias inclusion in definition order, convenience-flag names, unnamed combinations yielding nothing, empty values yielding nothing); vb_reg.rs (pass_to_pass) compiles and passes at base, guarding iter_names decomposition and contains/bits/equality. Assertions compare collected name vectors from the tests' own flag definitions.
